-- Hatch animation: egg shakes, white flash, pets pop out spinning with name + rarity.
-- Legendary / Mythic add a rainbow burst, a banner and a UI shake. Driven by the HatchFx remote.
-- Never sinks input; full version < 3 s, auto-hatch version ~0.6 s.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local EggsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Eggs)
local PetsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets)
local UiStyle = require(script.Parent.UiStyle)
local PetsController = require(script.Parent.PetsController)

local HatchController = {}

local C = UiStyle.Colors
local MAX_QUEUE = 2

local EGG_COLORS = {
	Starter = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200),
	Buff = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60),
	Candy = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 200),
	CandyPlus = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 170),
	Frost = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255),
	FrostPlus = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255),
	Inferno = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 30),
	InfernoPlus = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30),
	Galaxy = Color3.fromRGB(120, 70, 220),
	GalaxyPlus = Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 160),
	Mega = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
}

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local stage: Frame? = nil
local queue = {}
local playing = false

local function tween(obj: Instance, t: number, props: { [string]: any }, style: Enum.EasingStyle?, dir: Enum.EasingDirection?): Tween
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function scaled(frame: GuiObject)
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = frame
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

-- Part-built egg (stretched sphere + spots) in a ViewportFrame
local function eggViewport(eggId: string): ViewportFrame
	local color = EGG_COLORS[eggId] or C.Gold
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Name = "Egg"
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vp.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	vp.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 260)
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.5, -1)
	vp.ZIndex = 5
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 40
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 7.5), Vector3.zero)
	camera.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = camera
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	local shell = Instance.new("Part")
	shell.Anchored = true
	shell.Size = Vector3.new(2.6, 3.3, 2.6)
	shell.Color = color
	shell.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Parent = shell
	shell.Parent = model
	local spot = UiStyle.Darken(color, 0.3)
	for i, offset in { Vector3.new(-0.7, 0.6, 1.05), Vector3.new(0.6, -0.3, 1.15), Vector3.new(-0.2, -1.1, 1.05), Vector3.new(0.5, 1.1, 0.9) } do
		local dot = Instance.new("Part")
		dot.Anchored = true
		dot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		local s = if i == 1 then 0.8 else 0.55
		dot.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
		dot.Color = if i % 2 == 0 then C.White else spot
		dot.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		dot.Position = offset
		dot.Parent = model
	end
	model.Parent = vp
	return vp
end

local function rainbowBurst(parent: Instance, hold: boolean)
	local burst = Instance.new("Frame")
	burst.Name = "Burst"
	burst.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	burst.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	burst.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.2)
	burst.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeXX
	burst.BackgroundColor3 = C.White
	burst.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	burst.ZIndex = 2
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = burst
	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 60)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 90)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(190, 80, 255)),
	})
	grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1),
	})
	grad.Parent = burst
	burst.Parent = parent
	tween(burst, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.4, 1.4) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		grad.Rotation = (grad.Rotation + dt * 180) % 360
	end)
	burst.Destroying:Connect(function()
		conn:Disconnect()
	end)
	if not hold then
		task.delay(1, function()
			if burst.Parent then
				tween(burst, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function shake(frame: GuiObject, duration: number, strength: number)
	task.spawn(function()
		local base = frame.Position
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < duration and frame.Parent do
			local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
			frame.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-strength, strength) * k, math.random(-strength, strength) * k)
			task.wait()
		end
		frame.Position = base
	end)
end

local function petReveal(petId: string, index: number, count: number, parent: Instance, delayTime: number): Frame
	local pet = PetsConfig.List[petId] or { Name = tostring(petId), Rarity = "Common", Power = 0 }
	local rarity = PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or PetsConfig.Rarities.Common
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Pet" .. index
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (index - (count + 1) / 2) * 240, 0.5, 0)
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 300)
	holder.ZIndex = 6
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 0
	scale.Parent = holder

	-- soft rarity glow behind the pet
	local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
	glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36)
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200)
	glow.BackgroundColor3 = rarity.Color
	glow.ZIndex = 6
	local gc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	gc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	gc.Parent = glow
	local gg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gg.Rotation = 90
	gg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.15, 0.9)
	gg.Parent = glow
	local gs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	gs.Thickness = 4
	gs.Color = C.Outline
	gs.Parent = glow
	glow.Parent = holder

	local vp = PetsController.Viewport(petId, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 210),
		ZIndex = 7,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	local model = vp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
	if model then
		local angle = math.pi
		local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			angle += dt * 2.5
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))
		end)
		holder.Destroying:Connect(function()
			conn:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "PetName",
		Text = pet.Name,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.72),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 38),
		MaxTextSize = 34,
		StrokeThickness = 4,
		ZIndex = 8,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Rarity",
		Text = pet.Rarity .. "  +" .. PetsController.Format(pet.Power),
		TextColor3 = rarity.Color,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.86),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 28),
		MaxTextSize = 26,
		StrokeThickness = 3,
		ZIndex = 8,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	holder.Parent = parent
	task.delay(delayTime, function()
		tween(scale, 0.35, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)
	return holder
end

local function banner(text: string, color: Color3, parent: Instance)
	local label = UiStyle.Label({
		Name = "Banner",
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = color,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -215),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 92),
		MaxTextSize = 84,
		StrokeThickness = 6,
		ZIndex = 9,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	label.Rotation = -4
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 0
	scale.Parent = label
	tween(scale, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

local function play(eggId: string, petIds: { string }, isAuto: boolean, hold: boolean?)
	local root = stage
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local scene = Instance.new("Frame")
	scene.Name = "Scene"
	scene.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scene.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	scene.Parent = root

	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(800, 600)
	center.ZIndex = 3
	center.Parent = scene
	scaled(center)

	-- 1. egg shakes harder and harder
	local shakeTime = if isAuto then 0.25 else 1.2
	local egg = eggViewport(eggId)
	egg.Parent = center
	local eggScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	eggScale.Scale = 0.6
	eggScale.Parent = egg
	tween(eggScale, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < shakeTime do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / shakeTime
		egg.Rotation = math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (4 + k * 22)
		eggScale.Scale = 1 + k * 0.15
		task.wait()
	end

	-- 2. white flash, egg cracks open
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Name = "Flash"
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = C.White
	flash.ZIndex = 20
	flash.Parent = scene
	tween(flash, if isAuto then 0.2 else 0.45, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	egg:Destroy()

	-- 3. reveal pets (best rarity decides the extras)
	local best = 0
	local bestRarity = "Common"
	for _, id in petIds do
		local pet = PetsConfig.List[id]
		local r = pet and PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity]
		if r and r.Order > best then
			best = r.Order
			bestRarity = pet.Rarity
		end
	end
	local count = math.min(#petIds, 3)
	for i = 1, count do
		petReveal(petIds[i], i, count, center, (i - 1) * (if isAuto then 0.03 else 0.12))
	end
	if bestRarity == "Legendary" or bestRarity == "Mythic" then
		rainbowBurst(scene, hold == true)
		local text = if bestRarity == "Mythic" then "MYTHIC!!" else "LEGENDARY!"
		banner(text, PetsConfig.Rarities[bestRarity].Color, center)
		shake(center, if isAuto then 0.3 else 0.6, if bestRarity == "Mythic" then 16 else 10)
	end
	if hold then
		return
	end

	-- 4. hold, then shrink away
	task.wait(if isAuto then 0.35 else 1.1)
	for _, child in center:GetChildren() do
		local s = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if s then
			tween(s, 0.2, { Scale = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		end
	end
	task.wait(0.22)
	scene:Destroy()
end

local function pump()
	if playing then
		return
	end
	playing = true
	while #queue > 0 do
		local job = table.remove(queue, 1)
		local ok, err = pcall(play, job[1], job[2], job[3])
		if not ok then
			warn("HatchController:", err)
		end
	end
	playing = false
end

local function build(parent: Instance)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	g.Name = "HatchGui"
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	g.DisplayOrder = 30
	local s = Instance.new("Frame")
	s.Name = "Stage"
	s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	s.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	s.Parent = g
	stage = s
	gui = g
	g.Parent = parent
end

-- Public so other UI (egg prompts, tests) can trigger the same animation
function HatchController.Play(eggId: string, petIds: { string }, isAuto: boolean?)
	if type(petIds) ~= "table" or #petIds == 0 then
		return
	end
	if #queue >= MAX_QUEUE then
		table.remove(queue, 1)
	end
	table.insert(queue, { eggId, petIds, isAuto == true })
	task.spawn(pump)
end

function HatchController.Start()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	build(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	remotes:WaitForChild("HatchFx").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(eggId, petIds, isAuto)
		if type(eggId) == "string" and EggsConfig.List[eggId] then
			HatchController.Play(eggId, petIds, isAuto)
		end
	end)
end

-- Edit-mode visual check only: freezes on the reveal so it can be screenshotted
function HatchController.Preview(parent: Instance, eggId: string, petIds: { string }): ScreenGui?
	build(parent)
	task.spawn(play, eggId, petIds, true, true)
	return gui
end

return HatchController

-- Builds the HUD in code (UiStyle buttons) and keeps it in sync with player
-- attributes. Visual only: every stat, unlock and purchase is decided on the server.
-- Passive Strength arrives once a second but is shown as +gain popups every 0.1s
-- with a smooth counter, so it feels like it never stops going up.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Config = Shared:WaitForChild("Config")
local Format = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("Format"))
local Purchase = require(Shared.Util:WaitForChild("Purchase"))
local Zones = require(Config:WaitForChild("Zones"))
local RebirthConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("Rebirth"))
local Monetization = require(Config:WaitForChild("Monetization"))

local ui = {}

local shownStrength = 0

local function make(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in props do
		inst[k] = v
	end
	for _, child in children or {} do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius)
	return make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 12)})
end

local function label(props)
	local l = make("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = FONT,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, {make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = DARK})})
	for k, v in props do
		l[k] = v
	end
	return l
end

	Pets = "\u{1F43E}",
	Shop = "\u{1F6D2}",
	Double = "\u{26A1}",
	AutoTrain = "\u{1F916}",
	AutoPunch = "\u{1F44A}",
	DoubleCoins = "\u{1FA99}",
	VIP = "\u{1F451}",
	Boost = "\u{1F680}",
	Train = "\u{1F4AA}",
}

local function button(name, text, color, size, parent, rainbow)

	return UiStyle.Button({
		Name = name,
		Text = text,
		Color = color,
		Size = size,
		Shape = if square then "Square" else "Wide",
		Icon = ICONS[name],
		Rainbow = rainbow == true,
		Parent = parent,
	})
end

local function scaled(frame)
	local scale = make("UIScale", {Parent = frame})
	local function update()
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 700), 0.55, 1)
	end
	update()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
end

local function attr(name, default)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil then
		return default
	end
	return value
end

local function optionalController(name)
	local module = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not module then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	return if ok then result else nil
end

-- toasts and popups
local function notify(text)
	local toast = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 40),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 118),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120),
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 128)}):Play()
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.4)
		toast:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function popup(text, color, big)
	local size = if big then UDim2.fromOffset(240, 46) else UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
	local p = label({
		Text = text,
		Size = size,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0, 0.42 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18, 0),
		TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
		Parent = ui.Gui,
	})
	local goal = {Position = p.Position - UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07), TextTransparency = 1}
	TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal):Play()
	task.delay(0.7, function()
		p:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function buyPass(passKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Pass(passKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

local function buyProduct(productKey)
	local ok, reason = Purchase.Product(productKey)
	if not ok and reason then
		notify(reason)
	end
end

-- owned auto pass = toggle it, not owned = buy it
local function autoButton(passKey, field, remote)
	return function()
		if attr("Pass_" .. passKey, false) then
			remote:FireServer(not attr(field, true))
		else
			buyPass(passKey)
		end
	end
end

local function train()
	local now = os.clock()
	while clickTimes[1] and now - clickTimes[1] > 1 do
		table.remove(clickTimes, 1)
	end
	if #clickTimes >= CLICK_LIMIT then
		return
	end
	table.insert(clickTimes, now)
	Remotes.Train:FireServer()
	popup("+" .. Format.Number(attr("Gain", 1) * StatsConfig.ClickValue) .. " \u{1F4AA}", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), true)
end

local function buildRebirthPanel()

	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Body.ZIndex = 0
	scaled(panel)
	panel.Close.Activated:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = false
	end)
	ui.RebirthFrom = label({Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 60), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 76), ZIndex = 20, Parent = panel})
	label({Text = "\u{27A1}", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 76), ZIndex = 20, Parent = panel})

local function passivePerSecond()
	local clicks = StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
	if attr("Pass_AutoTrain", false) and attr("AutoTrainOn", true) then
		clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks
	end
	return attr("Gain", 1) * clicks
end

function HudController.Start()
	buildHud()
	shownStrength = attr("Strength", 0)
	player.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(name)
		if name ~= "Strength" then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
	refresh()
	Remotes.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(notify)

	-- smooth counter: always creeping toward the real (server) value
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local target = attr("Strength", 0)
		if target < shownStrength then
			shownStrength = target
		else
			shownStrength += (target - shownStrength) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
		end
		ui.StrengthText.Text = "\u{1F4AA} " .. Format.Number(shownStrength) .. " Strength   +" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond()) .. "/sec"
	end)

	-- the illusion: a +gain popup every 0.1s
	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 1 / StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
		while true do
			task.wait(step)
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if attr("Loaded", false) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				popup("+" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond() * step), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- click or tap anywhere in the world to train
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			train()
		end
	end)

	-- live boost timer
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if timeLeft("BoostEnd") > -2 then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return HudController

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local PetVisual = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.PetVisual)

local PetController = {}

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "PetFollowers"
local followers = {}
local signatures = {}

local function clear(owner)
	for _, model in followers[owner] or {} do
		model:Destroy()
	end
	followers[owner] = {}
end

local function equippedIds(owner)
	local ok, inv = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, owner:GetAttribute("PetInv") or "[]")
	local ids = {}
	if ok and type(inv) == "table" then
		for _, entry in inv do
			if entry.e then
				table.insert(ids, entry.p)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(ids)
	return ids
end

local function rebuild(owner)
	local ids = equippedIds(owner)
	local signature = table.concat(ids, ",")
	if signatures[owner] == signature then
		return
	end
	signatures[owner] = signature
	clear(owner)
	for _, id in ids do
		local model = PetVisual.Make(id)
		model.Parent = folder
		table.insert(followers[owner], model)
	end
end

local function track(owner)
	followers[owner] = {}
	rebuild(owner)
	owner:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetInv"):Connect(function()
		rebuild(owner)
	end)
end

function PetController.Start()
	folder.Parent = workspace
	for _, owner in Players:GetPlayers() do
		track(owner)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(owner)
		clear(owner)
		followers[owner] = nil
		signatures[owner] = nil
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock()
		for owner, models in followers do
			local character = owner.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local scale = character:GetScale()
				local count = #models
				for i, model in models do
					-- half circle behind the player, bobbing, facing forward
					local angle = math.rad(-70 + (i - 0.5) * (140 / math.max(count, 1)))
					local radius = 4.5 * scale + 1
					local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle) * radius, 0.3 * scale + math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 0.5, math.cos(angle) * radius)
					local goal = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
					model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot():Lerp(goal, 0.15))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return PetController

local function sortedInventory(inv: { any }): { any }
	local list = table.clone(inv)
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if (a.e == true) ~= (b.e == true) then
			return a.e == true
		end
		local pa = PetsConfig.List[a.p]
		local pb = PetsConfig.List[b.p]
		local powA = if pa then pa.Power else 0
		local powB = if pb then pb.Power else 0
		if powA ~= powB then
			return powA > powB
		end
		return tostring(a.u) < tostring(b.u)
	end)
	return list
end

local function darken(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3
	local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s + amount * 0.2), v * (1 - amount))
end
UiStyle.Darken = darken

local function new(className: string, props: { [string]: any }, children: { Instance }?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in props do
		if k ~= "Parent" then
			(inst :: any)[k] = v
		end
	end
	if children then
		for _, child in children do
			child.Parent = inst
		end
	end
	if props.Parent then
		inst.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius: number): UICorner
	return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
end

local function stroke(thickness: number, color: Color3?, transparency: number?): UIStroke
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Thickness = thickness,
		Color = color or UiStyle.Colors.Outline,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
	})
end

-- Stud tile pattern: small rounded square outlines on a grid, refilled when the size changes
local function addStuds(parent: GuiObject, color: Color3, transparency: number, zIndex: number, inset: number): Frame
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Studs",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2),
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = zIndex,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	new("UIGridLayout", {
		CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD, STUD),
		CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD_GAP, STUD_GAP),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	local count = 0
	local function fill()
		local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
		local cell = STUD + STUD_GAP
		local want = math.min(MAX_STUDS, math.ceil(size.X / cell) * math.ceil(size.Y / cell))
		while count < want do
			count += 1
			new("Frame", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ZIndex = zIndex,
				Parent = holder,
			}, { corner(3), stroke(1.5, color, transparency) })
		end
	end
	holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fill)
	task.defer(fill)
	return holder
end

-- Big chunky button. Stable children for other code: Label (TextLabel), Badge (Frame, hidden), Icon (when given)
function UiStyle.Button(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local color: Color3 = props.Color or UiStyle.Colors.Blue
	local shape = props.Shape or "Wide"
	local z = props.ZIndex or 2
	local radius = props.CornerRadius or (if shape == "Square" then 12 else 8)

	local button = new("TextButton", {
		Name = props.Name or "Button",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or (if shape == "Square" then UDim2.fromOffset(96, 96) else UDim2.fromOffset(200, 56)),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = z,
	})
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Name = "Scale", Parent = button })

	-- Lip: darker copy of the fill under the face, carries the outer outline
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Lip",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 140) else darken(color, 0.45),
		ZIndex = z,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius), stroke(OUTLINE) })

	local face = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Face",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LIP),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else color,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius) })
	if props.Rainbow then
		new("UIGradient", { Color = RAINBOW, Rotation = -30, Parent = face })
	end

	if props.Studs ~= false then
		addStuds(face, darken(color, 0.5), 0.55, z + 2, math.floor(radius / 2))
	end

	-- Shade: bottom of the face gets darker
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Shade",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		ZIndex = z + 3,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(radius),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.72),
			}),
		}),
	})

	-- Gloss: soft white band on the top half
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Gloss",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.45, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = z + 4,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(math.max(radius - 3, 2)),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.92),
			}),
		}),
	})

	local dim = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Dim",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = z + 5,
		Parent = face,
	}, { corner(radius) })

	local label = UiStyle.Label({
		Text = props.Text or "",
		ZIndex = z + 7,
		MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize,
		StrokeThickness = props.StrokeThickness or 3,
	})

	if props.Icon ~= nil and props.Icon ~= "" then
		local icon = makeIcon(props.Icon, z + 6)
		if shape == "Square" then
			-- big icon fills the top and pokes past the edge like the reference
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.08)
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.78)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -LIP - 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.3)
		else
			-- icon hangs off the left edge, label fills the rest
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, -10, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			icon.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -8, 0.72, 0)
		end
		icon.Parent = button
	else
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.72, 0)
	end
	label.Parent = button

	local badge = makeBadge(z + 8)
	badge.Visible = props.Badge == true
	badge.Parent = button

	-- Hover / press feel: scale bump, face sinks into the lip, darkens
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local hovering = false
	local function setState(state: string)
		local s = if state == "press" then 0.93 elseif state == "hover" then 1.06 else 1
		local d = if state == "press" then 0.75 elseif state == "hover" then 0.92 else 1
		local y = if state == "press" then LIP - 1 else 0
		TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = s }):Play()

-- One saved profile per player. Never overwrites data after a failed load.
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = {}

local STORE_NAME = "StatSim_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 120
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 50

local store = nil
local profiles = {}
local canSave = {}
local loadedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
DataService.ProfileLoaded = loadedEvent.Event

local function defaults()
	return {
		Strength = 0,
		TotalStrength = 0,
		XP = 0,
		Level = 1,
		Rebirths = 0,
		BoostEnd = 0,
		AutoTrainOn = true,
		Coins = 0,
		BestPunch = 0,
		PetInv = {},
		NextPetUid = 1,
		CoinBoostEnd = 0,
		LuckEnd = 0,
		AutoPunchOn = true,
		AutoHatchOn = true,
		WorldUnlocked = 1,
		Receipts = {},
		ReceiptOrder = {},
	}
end

local function reconcile(data)
	for key, value in defaults() do
		if data[key] == nil then
			data[key] = value
		end
	end
	return data
end

local function withRetries(fn)
	local attempts = if RunService:IsStudio() then 1 else 3
	local lastErr = nil
	for attempt = 1, attempts do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastErr = result
		if attempt < attempts then
			task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1))
		end
	end
	return false, lastErr
end

local function key(player)
	return "player_" .. player.UserId
end

function DataService.Load(player)
	local ok, data = false, nil
	if store then
		ok, data = withRetries(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key(player))
		end)
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	if ok then
		profiles[player] = reconcile(data or defaults())
		canSave[player] = true
	elseif RunService:IsStudio() then
		warn("[DataService] DataStore not available in Studio. Using temp data, nothing saves. Turn on Game Settings > Security > Studio API access to test saving.")
		profiles[player] = defaults()
		canSave[player] = false
	else
		warn("[DataService] Load failed for " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(data))
		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin.")
		return
	end
	loadedEvent:Fire(player, profiles[player])
end

-- Returns true when the profile is safely stored (or saving is off in Studio)
function DataService.Save(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then
		return false
	end
	if not canSave[player] then
		return true
	end
	local ok, err = withRetries(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key(player), function()
			return profile
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[DataService] Save failed for " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok
end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.HasReceipt(profile, purchaseId)
	return profile.Receipts[purchaseId] == true
end

function DataService.AddReceipt(profile, purchaseId)
	profile.Receipts[purchaseId] = true
	table.insert(profile.ReceiptOrder, purchaseId)
	while #profile.ReceiptOrder > MAX_RECEIPTS do
		local old = table.remove(profile.ReceiptOrder, 1)
		profile.Receipts[old] = nil
	end
end

function DataService.Start()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(DataService.Load)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(DataService.Load, player)
	end

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		DataService.Save(player)
		profiles[player] = nil
		canSave[player] = nil
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				DataService.Save(player)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		while pending > 0 do
			task.wait()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				task.spawn(DataService.Save, player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

-- Global top 10 by lifetime Strength on the board in Workspace.Map.Leaderboard.
-- Falls back to players in this server if the OrderedDataStore is not available.
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local LeaderboardService = {}

local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60
local TOP = 10
local names = {}

local function nameFor(userId)
	if names[userId] then
		return names[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, userId)
	names[userId] = if ok then name else "Player"
	return names[userId]
end

local function getList()
	local board = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard")
	local gui = board and board:FindFirstChild("Board") and board.Board:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
	return gui and gui:FindFirstChild("List")
end

local function render(rows)
	local list = getList()
	if not list then
		return
	end
	for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for rank, row in rows do
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Row" .. rank
		label.LayoutOrder = rank
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.085, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.TextColor3 = if rank == 1 then Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60) elseif rank <= 3 then Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255) else Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		label.Text = "#" .. rank .. "  " .. row.Name .. "  " .. Format.Number(row.Value)
		label.Parent = list
	end
end

local function serverRows()
	local rows = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		if profile then
			table.insert(rows, {Name = player.Name, Value = profile.TotalStrength})
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		return a.Value > b.Value
	end)
	while #rows > TOP do
		table.remove(rows)
	end
	return rows
end

local function refresh(store)
	if store then
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local profile = DataService.Get(player)
			if profile then
				pcall(store.SetAsync, store, tostring(player.UserId), math.floor(profile.TotalStrength))
			end
		end
		local ok, pages = pcall(store.GetSortedAsync, store, false, TOP)
		if ok then
			local rows = {}
			for _, entry in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
				table.insert(rows, {Name = nameFor(tonumber(entry.key)), Value = entry.value})
			end
			render(rows)
			return
		end
	end
	render(serverRows())
end

function LeaderboardService.Start()
	local ok, store = pcall(DataStoreService.GetOrderedDataStore, DataStoreService, "TopStrength_v1")
	if not ok then
		store = nil
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(5)
		while true do
			refresh(store)
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardService

-- Gamepass ownership + the ONE ProcessReceipt for the whole game.
-- Grants happen only here, on the server. The client only opens Roblox prompts.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization)
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)
local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.RebirthService)
local PunchService = require(script.Parent.PunchService)
local EggService = require(script.Parent.EggService)

local MonetizationService = {}

local function grantStrength(player, product)
	StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * product.Clicks)
end

local function grantCoins(player, product)
	StatService.AddCoins(player, math.max(PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player), 10) * product.Punches)
end

local function timed(field)
	return function(player, product)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		profile[field] = math.max(profile[field], os.time()) + product.Seconds
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end
end

local grants = {
	StrengthSmall = grantStrength,
	StrengthMedium = grantStrength,
	StrengthLarge = grantStrength,
	CoinsSmall = grantCoins,
	CoinsMedium = grantCoins,
	CoinsLarge = grantCoins,
	Boost = timed("BoostEnd"),
	CoinBoost = timed("CoinBoostEnd"),
	LuckBoost = timed("LuckEnd"),
	Level = function(player)
		StatService.AddLevels(player, 1)
	end,
	RebirthSkip = function(player)
		RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, false)
	end,
	WorldSkip = function(player)
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		profile.WorldUnlocked = math.min(StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) + 1, #Zones.List)
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end,
	MegaEgg = function(player)
		EggService.Hatch(player, "Mega", 1, false, true)
	end,
}

local function processReceipt(info)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- Already granted earlier: only confirm once it is saved
	if DataService.HasReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId) then
		if DataService.Save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local productKey, product = Monetization.FindProduct(info.ProductId)
	if not productKey or not grants[productKey] then
		warn("[Monetization] Unknown product " .. tostring(info.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(grants[productKey], player, product)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Monetization] Grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	DataService.AddReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. product.Name .. " received")

	if DataService.Save(player) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

local function checkPasses(player)
	for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, owns = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, pass.Id)
			if ok and owns then
				StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Studio only: buttons whose Id is still 0 grant for free so we can test them.
-- Live servers ignore this remote completely.
local function onStudioPurchase(player, kind, itemKey)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return
	end
	if typeof(kind) ~= "string" or typeof(itemKey) ~= "string" or not DataService.Get(player) then
		return
	end
	if kind == "Pass" then
		local pass = Monetization.Passes[itemKey]
		if pass and pass.Id == 0 then
			StatService.SetPass(player, itemKey, true)
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "[Studio test] " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
		end
	elseif kind == "Product" then
		local product = Monetization.Products[itemKey]
		if product and product.Id == 0 and grants[itemKey] then
			grants[itemKey](player, product)
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "[Studio test] " .. product.Name .. " received")
		end
	end
end

function MonetizationService.Start()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt
	Remotes.StudioPurchase.OnServerEvent:Connect(onStudioPurchase)
	DataService.ProfileLoaded:Connect(checkPasses)

	-- Fired by Roblox on the server, so the client cannot fake it
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased or passId == 0 then
			return
		end
		for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
			if pass.Id == passId then
				StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
				Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MonetizationService

-- Punch the dummy (ProximityPrompt + Auto Punch pass). The server decides the
-- feet, the Coins and where on the track it lands; clients only animate it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local PunchConfig = require(Config.Punch)
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local PunchService = {}

local lastPunch = {}
local dummy = nil

-- Coins one punch would give right now (also used by Coin products)
function PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return 0
	end
	local feet = PunchConfig.Feet(profile.Strength)
	local world = Zones.List[StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)]
	return PunchConfig.Coins(feet, world.Multiplier, StatService.CoinMultiplier(player)), feet
end

local function punch(player, isAuto)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPunch[player] and now - lastPunch[player] < PunchConfig.Cooldown then
		return
	end
	lastPunch[player] = now

	local coins, feet = PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player)
	StatService.AddCoins(player, coins)
	if feet > profile.BestPunch then
		profile.BestPunch = feet
		StatService.Refresh(player)
		if not isAuto then
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "NEW BEST: " .. Format.Number(feet) .. " FT!")
		end
	end
	Remotes.PunchFx:FireAllClients(player, feet, coins, PunchConfig.TrackX(feet), isAuto)
end

local function onPrompt(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not dummy then
		return
	end
	local reach = PunchConfig.MaxRange * character:GetScale()
	if (root.Position - dummy:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude > reach then
		return
	end
	punch(player, false)
end

function PunchService.Start()
	dummy = workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):WaitForChild("PunchLane"):WaitForChild("Dummy")
	dummy.PrimaryPart:WaitForChild("PunchPrompt").Triggered:Connect(onPrompt)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastPunch[player] = nil
	end)

	-- Auto Punch pass: punches for you anywhere until you turn it off
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(PunchConfig.AutoInterval)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local profile = DataService.Get(player)
				if profile and profile.AutoPunchOn and StatService.OwnsPass(player, "AutoPunch") then
					punch(player, true)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return PunchService

-- Owns Strength, XP, Level, Coins and every multiplier. Replicates state as
-- player attributes (the client only reads them).
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local StatsConfig = require(Config.Stats)
local PunchConfig = require(Config.Punch)
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local RebirthConfig = require(Config.Rebirth)
local PetsConfig = require(Config.Pets)
local Gym = require(Config.Gym)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local StatService = {}

local owned = {}
local currentWorld = {}
local currentGym = {}

function StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, value)
	owned[player] = owned[player] or {}
	owned[player][passKey] = value
	player:SetAttribute("Pass_" .. passKey, value)
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

function StatService.OwnsPass(player, passKey)
	return owned[player] ~= nil and owned[player][passKey] == true
end

function StatService.SetLocation(player, world, gymTier)
	if currentWorld[player] == world and currentGym[player] == gymTier then
		return
	end
	currentWorld[player] = world
	currentGym[player] = gymTier
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

function StatService.CurrentWorld(player)
	return currentWorld[player] or 1
end

-- Highest world the player may enter (Strength or the World Skip product)
function StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)
	local allowed = 1
	for i, world in Zones.List do
		if profile.Strength >= world.Required then
			allowed = i
		end
	end
	return math.max(allowed, math.min(profile.WorldUnlocked or 1, #Zones.List))
end

function StatService.GymUnlocked(player, tier)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local info = Gym.Tiers[tier]
	if not profile or not info then
		return false
	end
	if info.Pass then
		return StatService.OwnsPass(player, info.Pass)
	end
	return profile.Rebirths >= (info.Rebirths or 0)
end

function StatService.EquippedIds(profile)
	local ids = {}
	for _, entry in profile.PetInv do
		if entry.e then
			table.insert(ids, entry.p)
		end
	end
	return ids
end

function StatService.PetSlots(player)
	return PetsConfig.BaseSlots + (if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "PetSlots") then PetsConfig.ExtraSlotsPass else 0)
end

function StatService.Multipliers(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local world = Zones.List[currentWorld[player] or 1]
	local gymTier = currentGym[player]
	local gamepass = 1
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "Double") then
		gamepass *= 2
	end
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "VIP") then
		gamepass *= 1.5
	end
	return {
		World = world.Multiplier,
		Gym = if gymTier then Gym.Tiers[gymTier].Multiplier else 1,
		Rebirth = if profile then RebirthConfig.Multiplier(profile.Rebirths) else 1,
		Gamepass = gamepass,
		Pets = if profile then PetsConfig.Multiplier(StatService.EquippedIds(profile)) else 1,
		Boost = if profile and profile.BoostEnd > os.time() then 2 else 1,
	}
end

function StatService.Gain(player)
	local total = StatsConfig.BaseGain
	for _, value in StatService.Multipliers(player) do
		total *= value
	end
	return total
end

function StatService.CoinMultiplier(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local m = 1
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "DoubleCoins") then
		m *= 2
	end
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "VIP") then
		m *= 1.5
	end
	if profile and profile.CoinBoostEnd > os.time() then
		m *= 2
	end
	return m
end

function StatService.IsLucky(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	return StatService.OwnsPass(player, "Lucky") or (profile ~= nil and profile.LuckEnd > os.time())
end

function StatService.Refresh(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local mults = StatService.Multipliers(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Strength", profile.Strength)
	player:SetAttribute("XP", profile.XP)
	player:SetAttribute("XPNeeded", StatsConfig.XpForLevel(profile.Level))
	player:SetAttribute("Level", profile.Level)
	player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", profile.Rebirths)
	player:SetAttribute("Gain", StatService.Gain(player))
	player:SetAttribute("Zone", currentWorld[player] or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("GymTier", currentGym[player] or 0)
	player:SetAttribute("AllowedZone", StatService.AllowedWorld(profile))
	player:SetAttribute("BoostEnd", profile.BoostEnd)
	player:SetAttribute("CoinBoostEnd", profile.CoinBoostEnd)
	player:SetAttribute("LuckEnd", profile.LuckEnd)
	player:SetAttribute("AutoTrainOn", profile.AutoTrainOn)
	player:SetAttribute("AutoPunchOn", profile.AutoPunchOn)
	player:SetAttribute("AutoHatchOn", profile.AutoHatchOn)
	player:SetAttribute("Coins", profile.Coins)
	player:SetAttribute("CoinMult", StatService.CoinMultiplier(player))
	player:SetAttribute("BestPunch", profile.BestPunch)
	player:SetAttribute("BestPunchStage", PunchConfig.StageAtFeet(profile.BestPunch))
	player:SetAttribute("PetSlots", StatService.PetSlots(player))
	player:SetAttribute("PetInv", HttpService:JSONEncode(profile.PetInv))
	for name, value in mults do
		player:SetAttribute("Mult_" .. name, value)
	end

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats then
		stats.Strength.Value = math.min(math.floor(profile.Strength), 2 ^ 53)
		stats.Coins.Value = math.min(math.floor(profile.Coins), 2 ^ 53)
		stats.Rebirths.Value = profile.Rebirths
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		local speed = StatsConfig.WalkSpeed(profile.Strength)
		if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "FastWalk") then
			speed *= 1.5
		end
		if not character:GetAttribute("Frozen") then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
		end
		local target = StatsConfig.BodyScale(profile.Strength)
		if math.abs(character:GetScale() - target) > 0.02 then
			character:ScaleTo(target)
		end
	end
end

function StatService.AddStrength(player, amount)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	profile.Strength += amount
	profile.TotalStrength += amount
	profile.XP += amount
	while profile.XP >= StatsConfig.XpForLevel(profile.Level) do
		profile.XP -= StatsConfig.XpForLevel(profile.Level)
		profile.Level += 1
	end
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

function StatService.AddLevels(player, count)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	profile.Level += count
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

function StatService.AddCoins(player, amount)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	profile.Coins += amount
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

local function onLoaded(player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	for _, name in {"Strength", "Coins", "Rebirths"} do
		local v = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		v.Name = name
		v.Parent = stats
	end
	stats.Parent = player
	player:SetAttribute("Loaded", true)
	StatService.Refresh(player)
end

function StatService.Start()
	DataService.ProfileLoaded:Connect(onLoaded)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.defer(StatService.Refresh, player)
		end)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		owned[player] = nil
		currentWorld[player] = nil
		currentGym[player] = nil
	end)
end

return StatService

ServerScriptService.Services.TrainingSer.source:
-- Free Strength every second for everyone, clicks on top (rate limited),
-- extra auto clicks for Auto Click owners. Popups are drawn by the client.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local StatsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Stats)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local TrainingService = {}

local clickWindows = {}

local function isAlive(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function onTrain(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local window = clickWindows[player]
	if not window or now - window.Start >= 1 then
		window = {Start = now, Count = 0}
		clickWindows[player] = window
	end
	window.Count += 1
	if window.Count > StatsConfig.MaxClicksPerSecond then
		return
	end
	if not DataService.Get(player) or not isAlive(player) then
		return
	end
	StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * StatsConfig.ClickValue)
end

local function toggler(field)
	return function(player, on)
		if typeof(on) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		if not profile then
			return
		end
		profile[field] = on
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end
end

function TrainingService.Start()
	Remotes.Train.OnServerEvent:Connect(onTrain)
	Remotes.ToggleAutoTrain.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoTrainOn"))
	Remotes.ToggleAutoPunch.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoPunchOn"))
	Remotes.ToggleAutoHatch.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoHatchOn"))
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		clickWindows[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(StatsConfig.TickSeconds)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local profile = DataService.Get(player)
				if profile and isAlive(player) then
					local clicks = StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
					if profile.AutoTrainOn and StatService.OwnsPass(player, "AutoTrain") then
						clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks
					end
					StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * clicks)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return TrainingService

ServerScriptService.Services.ZoneService.source:
-- Where is each player: which world (by distance to world centers) and which
-- gym pad. Portals teleport (server checks Strength). Gym pads with a pass
-- lock get a buy prompt.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Gym = require(Config.Gym)
local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization)
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local ZoneService = {}

local CHECK_SECONDS = 0.25
local lastAllowed = {}
local lastTeleport = {}
local gymPads = {}

local function gameplay()
	return workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay")
end

local function worldAt(position)
	for i = #Zones.List, 2, -1 do
		local c = Zones.List[i].Center
		if (Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z) - Vector3.new(c.X, 0, c.Z)).Magnitude < Zones.Radius then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

local function gymAt(position)
	for tier, pad in gymPads do
		local rel = pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if math.abs(rel.X) <= pad.Size.X / 2 + 1 and math.abs(rel.Z) <= pad.Size.Z / 2 + 1 and rel.Y < 12 and rel.Y > -2 then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hubSpawn()
	local spawnPart = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	return if spawnPart then spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) else CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function teleportTo(player, world)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if world == 1 then
		character:PivotTo(hubSpawn())
		return
	end
	local folder = gameplay().Worlds:FindFirstChild("World" .. world)
	local spawnPart = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("WorldSpawn")
	if spawnPart then
		character:PivotTo(spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
end

local function tryTeleport(player, world)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile or not Zones.List[world] then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastTeleport[player] and now - lastTeleport[player] < 2 then
		return
	end
	if world > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then
		lastTeleport[player] = now
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(Zones.List[world].Required) .. " Strength for " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World")
		return
	end
	lastTeleport[player] = now
	teleportTo(player, world)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Welcome to " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World! x" .. Zones.List[world].Multiplier .. " Strength here")
end

local function label(parent, text, offset)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "Label"
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 90)
	bb.StudsOffset = offset
	bb.MaxDistance = 140
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.RichText = true
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	t.Text = text
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = 3
	s.Parent = t
	t.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = parent
	return t
end

local function promptPass(player, passKey)
	local pass = Monetization.Passes[passKey]
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, passKey) then
		return
	end
	if pass.Id == 0 then
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "[Studio test] " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
		else
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, pass.Name .. " is coming soon")
		end
		return
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id)
end

local function setupPortals()
	for _, pad in gameplay().Portals:GetChildren() do
		local world = pad:GetAttribute("World")
		local info = Zones.List[world]
		label(pad, string.format("%s WORLD\n<font size=\"22\">Need %s Strength \u{2022} x%d</font>", string.upper(info.Name), Format.Number(info.Required), info.Multiplier), Vector3.new(0, 9, 0))
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if player then
				tryTeleport(player, world)
			end
		end)
	end
	for _, folder in gameplay().Worlds:GetChildren() do
		local back = folder:FindFirstChild("ReturnPortal")
		if back then
			label(back, "BACK TO HUB", Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			back.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if player then
					tryTeleport(player, 1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function setupGym()
	for _, pad in gameplay().GymPads:GetChildren() do
		local tier = pad:GetAttribute("Tier")
		local info = Gym.Tiers[tier]
		if info then
			gymPads[tier] = pad
			local need = if info.Pass then Monetization.Passes[info.Pass].Name else (if (info.Rebirths or 0) > 0 then info.Rebirths .. " Rebirths" else "FREE")
			label(pad, string.format("%s\n<font color=\"#9BFF8A\">x%d STRENGTH</font>\n<font size=\"20\">%s</font>", string.upper(info.Name), info.Multiplier, need), Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			if info.Pass then
				local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.Name = "BuyPrompt"
				prompt.ActionText = "Unlock " .. info.Name
				prompt.ObjectText = "x" .. info.Multiplier .. " Strength"
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
				prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
				prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F
				prompt.Parent = pad
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
					promptPass(player, info.Pass)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function check(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not profile or not root then
		return
	end
	local allowed = StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)
	if lastAllowed[player] and allowed > lastAllowed[player] then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, Zones.List[allowed].Name .. " World unlocked! Take the portal in the hub")
	end
	lastAllowed[player] = allowed

	local world = worldAt(root.Position)
	if world > allowed then
		teleportTo(player, 1)
		world = 1
	end
	local gymTier = if world == 1 then gymAt(root.Position) else nil
	if gymTier and not StatService.GymUnlocked(player, gymTier) then
		gymTier = nil
	end
	StatService.SetLocation(player, world, gymTier)
end

function ZoneService.Start()
	setupPortals()
	setupGym()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAllowed[player] = nil
		lastTeleport[player] = nil
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(CHECK_SECONDS)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				check(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return ZoneService

-- Eggs. Odds are shown to players on the egg board and in the hatch UI
-- (required for any random item, and always for the Robux egg).
-- Chance values are percents and add up to 100 per egg.
local Eggs = {}

local STANDARD = {55, 28, 12, 4, 0.9, 0.1}

local function egg(name, world, cost, petIds)
	local pets = {}
	for i, id in petIds do
		table.insert(pets, {Id = id, Chance = STANDARD[i]})
	end
	return {Name = name, World = world, Cost = cost, Pets = pets}
end

Eggs.List = {

		if lucky and i >= 4 and #e.Pets == 6 then

local Levels=require(script.Parent.PunchLevels)

for _,v in ipairs(Levels.List) do table.insert(Punch.Biomes,v[2]) end
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n<math.huge and n>-math.huge end
function Punch.Feet(strength)
 assert(finite(strength) and strength>=0,"Invalid strength")
 return math.floor(3.3*strength)+5
end
function Punch.Coins(feet,worldMultiplier,coinMultiplier)
 assert(finite(feet) and feet>=0,"Invalid distance")
 return math.floor(feet^.75*2*worldMultiplier*coinMultiplier)
end
function Punch.Progress(feet)
 assert(finite(feet) and feet>=0,"Invalid distance")
 return math.max(0,(math.log10(math.max(feet,10))-1)*Punch.LevelsPerDecade)
end
function Punch.StageAtFeet(feet) return math.floor(Punch.Progress(feet)+1e-9)+1 end
function Punch.Threshold(stage)
 assert(type(stage)=="number" and stage>=1 and stage%1==0,"Invalid stage")
 return 10^(1+(stage-1)/Punch.LevelsPerDecade)
end
function Punch.TrackX(feet) return Punch.TrackStartX+Punch.Progress(feet)*Punch.BiomeLength end
function Punch.BiomeAt(x)
 assert(finite(x),"Invalid virtual coordinate")
 local index=math.max(1,math.floor((x-Punch.TrackStartX)/Punch.BiomeLength+1e-9)+1)
 return index,Levels.Get(index).name
end
function Punch.Route(feet)
 local stage=Punch.StageAtFeet(feet)
 local count=math.min(stage,Punch.MaxVisibleStages)
 local route={}
 for i=1,count do
  local index=if count==1 then stage else 1+math.floor((stage-1)*(i-1)/(count-1)+.5)
  table.insert(route,{stage=index,x=Punch.TrackStartX+(i-1)*Punch.BiomeLength,warp=i>1 and index>route[i-1].stage+1})
 end
 -- Presentation is deliberately rebased near the hub, not a trillion-stud world.
 -- Reached stages/distance are not capped. Long flights use clearly marked portals
 -- between sampled milestones and always render the actual destination.
 local fraction=Punch.Progress(feet)%1
 local landing=route[#route].x+55+fraction*185
 return route,landing
end
return Punch

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format.source:
-- 1234 -> 1.2K, 5600000 -> 5.6M
local Format = {}

local SUFFIXES = {"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc"}

function Format.Number(n)
	if n >= 1e36 and n < math.huge then
		local e=math.floor(math.log10(n));return string.format("%.2fe%d",n/10^e,e)
	end
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(n)
	end
	local i = 1
	local v = n
	while v >= 1000 and i < #SUFFIXES do
		v /= 1000
		i += 1
	end
	if v >= 100 then
		return math.floor(v) .. SUFFIXES[i]
	end
	local s = string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10)
	s = string.gsub(s, "%.0$", "")
	return s .. SUFFIXES[i]
end

function Format.Multiplier(m)
	local s = string.format("%.2f", m)
	s = string.gsub(s, "0+$", "")
	s = string.gsub(s, "%.$", "")
	return "x" .. s
end

return Format

-- Makes a pet model: a clone from ReplicatedStorage.PetModels.<petId> if it

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PetsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Pets)

	local pet = PetsConfig.List[index] or {Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Rarity = "Common"}

		local eye = Instance.new("Part")
		eye.Name = "Eye"
		eye.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		eye.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		eye.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
		eye.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * 0.5, 0.35, -1.1)
		eye.Parent = model
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = body
		weld.Part1 = eye
		weld.Parent = eye
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	if rarity and rarity.Order >= 4 then
		local glow = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		glow.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		glow.Rate = 8
		glow.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
		glow.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
		glow.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		glow.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.5, 0)
		glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color)
		glow.Parent = body
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = rarity.Color
		light.Range = 8
		light.Parent = body
	end
	return model
end

function PetVisual.Make(index)
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PetModels")
	local source = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
	local model = if source and source:IsA("Model") then source:Clone() else placeholder(index)
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	end
	-- every pet is the same size no matter how the source model was built
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local biggest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	if biggest > 0 then
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * PET_SIZE / biggest)
	end
	return model
end

return PetVisual

function Builder.Distance(n)

end
-- Old decorative hub cliffs sit behind the first three track worlds. Mask only

function Builder.MaskHub(hub)
 local changed={}
 if not hub then return changed end
 for _,name in ipairs({"Cliffs","Hills","Trees"}) do
  local folder=hub:FindFirstChild(name)
  if folder then for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
   if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Position.X+p.Size.X/2>=40 and p.Position.X-p.Size.X/2<1000
     and p.Position.Z+p.Size.Z/2>-197 and p.Position.Z-p.Size.Z/2< -43 then
    table.insert(changed,{part=p,previous=p.LocalTransparencyModifier})
    p.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
   end
  end end
 end
 return changed
end

-- Client helper: open the right Roblox purchase prompt, or in Studio grant
-- Id-0 items through the StudioPurchase remote (the server re-checks IsStudio).
-- The server grants everything; this only opens prompts and reads prices.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Monetization = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Monetization)

local Purchase = {}

local ROBUX = utf8.char(0xE002)
local IS_STUDIO = RunService:IsStudio()
local prices = {}

local function remotes()
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
end

-- Returns true if it did something, false + reason otherwise
function Purchase.Pass(passKey)
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local pass = Monetization.Passes[passKey]
	if not pass then
		return false, "Unknown pass"
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. passKey) then
		return false, "You already own " .. pass.Name
	end
	if pass.Id == 0 then
		if IS_STUDIO then
			remotes().StudioPurchase:FireServer("Pass", passKey)
			return true
		end
		return false, pass.Name .. " is coming soon"
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id)
	return true
end

function Purchase.Product(productKey)
	local product = Monetization.Products[productKey]
	if not product then
		return false, "Unknown product"
	end
	if product.Id == 0 then
		if IS_STUDIO then
			remotes().StudioPurchase:FireServer("Product", productKey)
			return true
		end
		return false, product.Name .. " is coming soon"
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, product.Id)
	return true
end

-- Price label: real price from Roblox, "TEST" in Studio for Id 0, "Soon" live
function Purchase.PriceText(kind, key)
	local item = if kind == "Pass" then Monetization.Passes[key] else Monetization.Products[key]
	if not item or item.Id == 0 then
		return if IS_STUDIO then "TEST" else "Soon"
	end
	local cacheKey = kind .. item.Id
	if prices[cacheKey] == nil then
		local infoType = if kind == "Pass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
		local ok, info = pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfo, MarketplaceService, item.Id, infoType)
		prices[cacheKey] = if ok and info.PriceInRobux then info.PriceInRobux else false
	end
	return if prices[cacheKey] then ROBUX .. prices[cacheKey] else "..."
end

return Purchase
